Job Description SAP FICO Consultant (Swift 22002) with a strong understanding of Asset Accounting , Accounts Receivable , Accounts Payable , General Ledger , Interfaces , and Roles . The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in SAP FICO configurations and processes tailored working to optimize financial management systems and ensure seamless integration across systems. This role requires a consultant who can bridge the gap between finance and technology, driving efficiency and compliance through expert system configurations and management. Key Skills and Requirements: Experience: Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience as an SAP FICO Consultant, with a specific focus on Asset Accounting (Know Asset) , Accounts Receivable (AR) , Accounts Payable (AP) , Interfaces , and Roles . Configure FBZP, OBPM1/OBPM4, and integrate with F110 for proposal runs, file generation, and troubleshooting issues like DME not triggering. Customize remittance information, handle multi-vendor/invoice payments, and validate outputs against bank schemas (e.g., SEPA, CGI_XML_CT_V9). Proficiency in ABAP enhancements (e.g., BTE 00001050), LSMW for data loads, and XML validation tools Knowledge of S/4HANA clean core, tax integrations, and formats like pain.001.001.09 Test configurations via F110 simulations, debug with DMEE_DEBUG, and apply SAP Notes for country-specific tweaks. Strong configuration skills in SAP FICO, particularly in the context of Asset Accounting , AR , AP , and integration with other modules like MM, SD, and custom interfaces. Experience with data migration, integration tools, and working with IDocs , BAPIs for system interfacing. Knowledge of SAP Role Management to ensure proper security and access control. Good in Agile methodology Location -Noida, chennai , Bangalore Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to diagnose and resolve system issues quickly and efficiently. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with both technical teams and financial stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects, with a focus on detail and accuracy. Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to train and support users across different departments. Total Experience Expected: 08-10 years Location -Noida, chennai , Bangalore Qualifications Education and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field. SAP FICO Certification is preferred. Knowledge in Finance Regulations and accounting practices is a plus. Additional Information At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.
